name: Catering Procurement API
description: Source, compare, plan, and (human-approved) order catering for meetings, offices, events, and groups. /generate-catering-plan returns vendor_options and a recommended_order sized to attendee_count and budget in one call. Final vendor contact and ordering are execution-gated. Built for executive assistant, events, and workplace-ops agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Source catering for 40 people with vegetarian and halal needs under $20/head.
Compare three caterers on price, rating, lead time, and dietary coverage.
Generate a full catering plan with a recommended order for an event.
Prepare a catering order for sign-off before contacting the vendor.

agentUseCases.workflow: Generate a plan, vet the top vendor's reviews, then submit for human approval.
Recurring board-lunch catering with budget caps and approval gating.
Compare vendors across offices and standardize on the best-fit caterer.

human_approval_required.reason: Submitting an order or contacting a vendor is outward-facing and money-moving; an explicit human approval token is required.

chain_to.reason: Downscale a small event to a simple group order.
Find additional vendor candidates by cuisine.
Vet a caterer's reputation before ordering.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Call /generate-catering-plan with attendee_count, budget, diets, cuisines, window.
Vet the recommended vendor's reputation (chain to Review Sentiment).
Prepare the order, then submit /submit-catering-request for human approval.

examplePrompts: Find catering for 40 people, halal and vegetarian, under $20 a head for next Thursday.
Compare these three caterers on price and lead time.
Build me a catering plan for an all-hands lunch.
Prepare the catering order so my director can approve it.
